classification: preregistered three-asset defensive bucket and Top20 concentration repair; no weight grid

concentration_and_diversification_gates.C10_liquidity: same as D3 for the primary assets
concentration_and_diversification_gates.C5_recent_breadth: positive contributing stocks in the recent 12 months >=8
concentration_and_diversification_gates.C7_loss: maximum single-stock loss <=20% of stock gross profit
concentration_and_diversification_gates.C8_asset_contribution: no single asset contributes >50% of approximate total PnL
concentration_and_diversification_gates.C9_asset_weight: mean target weight of each defensive asset <=40% and maximum <=50%

data_gates.D1_asset_integrity: each asset has no duplicate dates, null close, or nonpositive close; alignment coverage with the equity curve >=95%
data_gates.D2_strategy_inputs: enriched equity data, extended factors, financial data, membership and all strategy dependencies are available and current through 2026-11-05; future-dated financial announcements are excluded by the PIT builder
data_gates.D3_primary_liquidity: each of the three primary defensive ETFs has median daily amount >= CNY 100m and minimum 20-day average amount >= CNY 50m over the strategy period

defensive_bucket.equity_vs_bucket: 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity between the frozen equity composite and the equal-weight defensive bucket daily return series; equity share bounds [0.2,0.8]
defensive_bucket.rebalance: first trading day of each month using only prior daily returns
defensive_bucket.weights: equal 1/3 each, rebalanced monthly with the overall portfolio

diagnostic_only.top10_same_bucket: descriptive check of holding-count effect; cannot be selected
diagnostic_only.top20_equity_only: same-data incremental control for the defensive bucket; cannot be selected

discipline: Equal 1/3 defensive weights and 60-day/15% parameters are copied from prior rounds; no weight, lookback, target-vol, TopN or threshold grid is allowed.
The first run is the result; execution bugs are preserved and corrected only through explicit amendments.
No production or paper order file is written in R331.

equity_engine.A_B_combination: 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity, A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% annualized volatility target [0.2,1.0] gross

known_limitations: The sample contains a strong gold bull market and a recent dividend/low-vol regime; historical performance is not proof of a permanent premium.
ETF qfq prices are vendor-reconstructed and are not an official point-in-time archive.
Industry classification remains a current snapshot backfilled through history.
Attribution is an approximate contribution-share diagnostic, not a tax or accounting ledger.
motivation: R325 gold-only passed performance/risk but failed stock top-five concentration and depended on gold for 74.59% of approximate PnL. R327 Top20 repaired stock concentration but had 2022 -1.50% and gold contribution 75.35%. R331 keeps Top20 and replaces the single gold ballast with an equal-weight gold / 10Y treasury / dividend ETF defensive bucket.

performance_gates.G10_no_leverage: all target weights nonnegative and sum <=1.0
performance_gates.G5_bootstrap: 252-day block bootstrap positive rate >=80% and return P05 >= -12%
performance_gates.G6_rolling_year: rolling 252-day positive rate >=70% and worst window >= -15%
performance_gates.G9_incremental: versus the same-data Top20 equity-only control: (Sharpe >= control+0.05 or MDD >= control+0.03) and annual return >= control-1pp

robustness_gates.R1_R3: each single-asset substitute has annualized return >=5%, MDD >= -20%, and 2022/2023 returns both >=0
robustness_gates.selection: the primary Top20 three-asset bucket must pass D1-D3 + G1-G10 + C1-C12 and all R1-R3; the Top10 diagnostic and equity-only control are not eligible candidates
